title: Delegate-timeout hardcoded op 600s, niet complexity-aware
source_context: Doppel sprint-2: DOP-007 XL 2x timeout op 600s
description: orchestrate.py gebruikt overal timeout=600 (run_delegate, _dag_delegate, run_team_sprint). L/XL-tickets timeouten daardoor structureel (zie DOP-007: 2x timeout, auto-blocked, moest handmatig gesplitst). Voorstel: timeout schalen op estimated_complexity (XS/S 600, M 900, L 1200, XL 1800) en overridebaar maken via .cto/config.json.
proposed_changes: COMPLEXITY_TIMEOUTS dict + cfg.get('delegate_timeouts', {}) merge; doorgeven op alle vier call-sites
